summary.text: Louis Gargiulo is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 24, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Louis Gargiulo, also known as Lou, was the Republican nominee for New Hampshire State Senate District 24 in 2020, when he lost to incumbent Tom Sherman, and again in 2022, when he lost to Debra Altschiller.
In 2026 he advanced from the Republican primary for the seat, and Altschiller, now the incumbent, advanced from the Democratic primary.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Gargiulo's campaign described him as an experienced business leader who built his Seacoast business into one of the largest real estate management companies in New England.
The same survey response said he would never support an income, sales or capital gains tax and would fight for a balanced budget.
